description: Abwasser Entsorgungsgebiete Thüringen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoproxy.geoportal-th.de. In Thuringia, the wastewater associations or the self-sustaining municipalities are responsible for the proper disposal of the waste water. The Thuringian-wide dataset contains the areas of association or disposal with further information on the relevant responsible bodies. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater Disposal Areas Thuringia" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Thüringen, ENER, Abwasser, GOVE, Ver- und Entsorgung. The listing shows 2026-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
